title: Color3
summary: An RGB color with 0–1 float channels. Build with Color3.new(r, g, b), Color3.fromRGB(0-255), or Color3.fromHSV. Lerp for gradients and smooth transitions.

methods.name: Color3.fromRGB
methods.description: Channels as 0–255 ints — matches most design tools.

explanation.whatItIs: A color value — three light channels, Roblox style.
explanation.whyItExists: Every Color property (parts, GUI, lighting) takes one.
whenToUse: Health bars: red→green Lerp by percentage
whenNotToUse: Hex strings — convert first (write a #RRGGBB parser or use fromRGB)
tips: fromRGB matches Studio's color picker — easiest mental bridge
Lerp for damage flashes and progress colors
commonMistakes: Color3.new(255, 0, 0) — that's >1 channels, blows out; use fromRGB

examples.title: Health-colored bar
examples.code:
local function healthColor(fraction)
    return Color3.new(1, 0, 0):Lerp(Color3.new(0, 1, 0), math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1))
end

bar.BackgroundColor3 = healthColor(0.7)   -- yellow-green

-- Rainbow part:
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        script.Parent.Color = Color3.fromHSV(os.clock() % 1, 1, 1)
        task.wait(0.05)
    end
end)
